text:
Noah (Design): quick design review for the tokens page. small, focused change: make visibility explicit at creation to reduce confusion.
Priya (PM): dropping in. main goal: fewer support tickets around 'where did my token go'. keep it compact.
Sam (Eng): current flow shows secret once in a drawer. if we add visibility options, backend needs a flag to persist vs ephemeral.
Ivy (A11y): if the secret is ephemeral, add announcement: 'This token will only be shown once.' and ensure focus returns to the token row after close.
Noah (Design): suggested UI: tiny 'Visibility' row under name with two radios: 'Ephemeral — shown once' and 'Recorded — stored & auditable'. default Ephemeral.
Priya (PM): default Ephemeral sounds right. add a small docs link in the toast.
Sam (Eng): recorded requires vault + audit events; mark as infra-impacting. ephemeral remains unchanged.
Noah (Design): copy swap: change CTA from 'Show secret' to 'Copy token (shown once)'. add 'Download .env (contains token)' as a secondary action.
Ivy (A11y): include sr-only confirmation when copied: 'Token copied to clipboard'. make download announcement explicit. toast should not auto-dismiss too fast.
Priya (PM): rotation UX: propose a toggle in rotate modal 'Keep old token active (grace)' with default off. when on, default 24h. show inline risk note.
Sam (Eng): backend can support configurable grace windows. we'll surface 'soft' vs 'hard' revoke in audit logs.
Ivy (A11y): modal focus lands on confirm, toggles are real checkboxes with aria-describedby. tooltips keyboard-focusable.
Noah (Design): list row micro: small status pill (Active / Revoked soft / Revoked hard). keep row height; show details on hover/focus.
infra-bot: "infra-bot: flagging epic-401 — token-visibility: KMS + audit store required."
Priya (PM): next steps: Noah posts two quick mocks (inline vs modal), Sam returns effort estimate, Ivy provides a short a11y checklist, I'll schedule security review.
Noah (Design): will post mocks shortly. thanks! :sparkles:
